messages:
support-queue: multiple APAC customers reporting truncated SSE streams + rapid reconnect loops since ~02:10 UTC. Customers see partial text, then client reconnects, duplicate billing entries in some invoices. ticket: INC-2029 <https://redwood.io/incident/INC-2029>
sam: seeing same in observability — increased error rate from streaming-proxy-apac. spike in `sse_fragment_mismatch` and `midframe_gap` counts.
lee: can you paste a sample log?
sam: pasted below from streaming-proxy pod `stream-proxy-3` (apac):
```
2024-11-06T02:12:08.321Z conn=abc123 stream_id=987 sse: received frame len=4096 offset=0
2024-11-06T02:12:08.322Z conn=abc123 stream_id=987 sse: received frame len=2048 offset=4096
2024-11-06T02:12:08.324Z conn=abc123 stream_id=987 sse: midframe_gap detected, expected offset=6144 got=8192
2024-11-06T02:12:08.325Z conn=abc123 stream_id=987 sse: closing connection, reason=frame_misaligned
```
priya: that `midframe_gap` matches the client repro we have — some clients buffer and push a larger chunk causing offset jumps. most affected are mobile SDK v0.9.2 and a handful of legacy polling fallbacks.
eng-oncall: acknowledging and triaging. initial hypothesis: NLB/ALB TCP segmentation + keepalive interplay causing chunk boundary changes + streaming-proxy frame size validation rejecting and closing.
ops-bot: alert: rolling restart initiated for streaming-proxy-apac (deployment/streaming-proxy, 3 pods).
sam: rolling restart started. also we pushed a hotfix to relax strict offset check (patch id: rp-2045) to avoid closing on single-frame mismatch. patch deployed to canary.
lee: can we quickly validate mitigation by routing one impacted customer to fallback path (non-streaming poll endpoint) and to a different model variant (smaller chunking)?
michael: support-queue -> we have one enterprise account (acct: AC-998) on Dedicated; switching them to polling fallback now and issuing a billing hold for streaming tokens during window. billing flagged potential duplicates and will dedupe request ids.
priya: repro steps for ENG/QA: 1) use mobile SDK v0.9.2, 2) send streaming request with `max_tokens=3200` on a flaky network emulator (packet reordering), 3) observe `midframe_gap` in proxy logs and client reconnect loop. share packet capture if needed.
eng-oncall: suggested next steps: a) keep hotfix in canary for 15m, b) if no regressions promote to apac, c) widen `tcp_keepalive` on NLB and bump streaming-proxy `max_frame_size` from 8k -> 16k as temporary mitigation, d) share status with customers and open follow-up for SDK fix.
sam: canary looks good for 10m (no additional closes). promoting to apac now.
status-bot: status update posted to portal: "APAC streaming: partial outputs + reconnects; mitigation in progress; routing/patch applied; some customers on fallback polling."
lee: follow-up: we'll add a telemetry flag to SDKs to include per-stream `client_frame_offsets` to help debug if this recurs.
michael: thanks — I'll keep billing hold until dedupe completes and will escalate any charge disputes. please add a short postmortem after incident closed. :thumbsup:
eng-oncall: tracking: INC-2029, follow-ups: SDK issue (SD-611), proxy hardening (RP-2046), billing dedupe (BIL-77). closing channel updates after 1h if stable.
support-queue: thanks — notifying affected customers about mitigations and temporary billing holds. will update when billing confirms dedupe.
